Messages.Body:
On Tue, 26 Jun 2007 20:00:20 -0700, seba <regie...@gmx.de> wrote:

>Deck Name: brujah weeny rush
>Created by: seba

>Description: Breed rush. so far untested. any comments ? would this
>build be tournament viable ?

There are ~15 similar decks, here:
http://games.groups.yahoo.com/group/rgtcjdeckarchive/msearch?query=brujah+debate

from which you might draw some inspiration.

>far too many master cards but all seem
>neede pot master can always be discarded patheon to help as is heart
>can this work ? no stealth or intercept (ecept carlton) do i need
>change of target or something like that ?

I would be using long range strikes, and I would swap the number of
Brujah Debates and Frontal Assaults.

>Crypt [12 vampires, average capacity: 4.42]
>4x Rake PRE aus cel pot 6 Brujah:1 prince
>4x Volker, The Puppet Prin CEL pot 5 Brujah:2 prince
>1x Dre, Leader of the Cold cel pot 3 Brujah:1
>1x Raziya Samater ani pot 3 Brujah:2
>1x Lupo pot 2 Brujah:1
>1x Hasina Kesi pot 1 Caitiff:1

Hasina gets no benefit from the Debates. She is the first to go.
You must not play this deck without Keyser Söze (Hector Sosa), so
swamp him in for Hasina. Slim down on the duplicates, and add Yuri
the Talon. Consider Bianca and Anvil to replace some of the other
duplicates. I would definitely not use more than 3 of each of the
princes, and I personally would be inclined to use the Eurobrujah as
well, but it will slow you down an extra turn to bring them out.

>Library [90 cards]
>Master [27]
>1x Barrens, The
>4x Blood Doll
>4x Brujah Debate
>2x Dreams of the Sphinx
>7x Frontal Assault
>3x Parthenon, The
>5x Potence
>1x Warzone Hunting Ground

>Action [10]
>10x Third Tradition: Progeny

Embraces would be a better choice, as Rake will always be tapped on
your turn. (If the Debates are working as you like.)

>Ally [2]
>1x Carlton Van Wyk (Hunter)
>1x Ossian

I don't know that Ossian fits here.

>Equipment [2]
>2x Heart of Nizchetus

>Event [1]
>1x Dragonbound

You are likely to have many weenies in torpor and no way to rescue
them with your current combat package. I would rethink this.

>Political Action [4]
>4x Consanguineous Boon

>Reaction [4]
>4x On the Qui Vive

Second Tradition is a vastly superior choice, as Rake will be tapped
for the Debates and you need to make use of him.

>Combat [40]
>10x Disarm
>15x Immortal Grapple
>15x Torn Signpost

I would swap Pulled Fangs for half of the Disarms. Once you have
Disarmed your prey's vampires, they can't be sent to torpor by a new
Disarm, and your predator will spend a little time rescuing your
prey's vampires just to slow you down.

Messages.Author: Peter D Bakija
Messages.Body:
In article <1182913220....@q75g2000hsh.googlegroups.com>,
seba <regie...@gmx.de> wrote:

> 4x Rake PRE aus cel pot 6 Brujah:1 prince
> 4x Volker, The Puppet Prin CEL pot 5 Brujah:2 prince
> 1x Dre, Leader of the Cold cel pot 3 Brujah:1
> 1x Raziya Samater ani pot 3 Brujah:2
> 1x Lupo pot 2 Brujah:1
> 1x Hasina Kesi pot 1 Caitiff:1

If you are going to go with 4 each of two mid cap princes, you might as
well go with 4 each of Constanza Vinti and Donnal O'Connor (i.e. the
Euro Brujah) if you can get them. They also have Dominate, which I hear
is good.

> Library [90 cards]
>
> Master [27]
>
> 1x Barrens, The
> 4x Blood Doll
> 4x Brujah Debate
> 2x Dreams of the Sphinx
> 7x Frontal Assault
> 3x Parthenon, The
> 5x Potence
> 1x Warzone Hunting Ground

27 masters is, as you note, way too many masters. And will get you
killed. On the up side, the potence masters come out quickly. Maybe turn
the 3 Parthenon, Barrens, 1 of the Blood Dolls, and Warzone Hunting
Ground into something else (Taste of Vitae?), leaving you at 21 masters,
of which 5 come out when you make kids. Also. having only Frontal
Assault as your Rush is dubious--you can only get your prey, so you can
defensively back rush. And if someone has a Sudden Reversal, you can't
do anything that turn. You also have no Fame. Which is problematic in a
deck like this.

>
> Action [10]
>
> 10x Third Tradition: Progeny
>
> Ally [2]
>
> 1x Carlton Van Wyk (Hunter)
> 1x Ossian

Ossian is probably not a good idea.

>
> Equipment [2]
>
> 2x Heart of Nizchetus
> Event [1]
>
> 1x Dragonbound

Dragonbound is just as likely to kill you as anyone else with all the
weenie vampires.

> Political Action [4]
>
> 4x Consanguineous Boon
>
> Reaction [4]
>
> 4x On the Qui Vive

Without intercept or reaction, these are better off as Rush actions. Or
Blood Hunt, so you can mark someone for mass rush abuse.

>
> Combat [40]
>
> 10x Disarm
> 15x Immortal Grapple
> 15x Torn Signpost

Well, here is the thing. Assuming you run into no:

-manevers
-fortitude
-guns

You'll be sending folks to torpor, but they'll get back out quickly, as
they are still going to have blood and you can't stop them from
rescuing. You have reasonable ousting power from a lot of little guys,
but limited defense. Anyone who has any sort of reasonable hit back
combat defense (guns, animalism) is going to shut you down and anyone
with reliable manuvers or fortitude is also going to shut you down.

I like the idea in theory, but it has flaws.

Peter D Bakija

Messages.Body:
Mass Debaters (Sorry about the doubling up)
Here is a Varity of a Brujah debate deck that has done well for me in
our meta group. Maybe some of these ideas may be of use for you. I
found I only really needed 2-3 debates in play to be effective. The
deck holds it own against other combat decks. Of course there are
combat decks that could/will trump this deck, this is why I went the
celerity angle as you can be more defensive when other combat....but
hey thats vtes, no one deck can guard against all others obviously.
Once set up it usually has had enough intercept to discourage and
defend the burning of Bru/Debates, and if they do get burnt it's not
so bad if you have the Anthelios in play, you can get the debate or
any master you want in your discard pile back if you need to, also
good for cycling masters. Oxford Uni is obviously for vote pushing but
it's also useful when your prey/pred have pool under yours and you
want to parity shift, call a KRC or some other vote that is not a
parity shift burn the required pool to add votes, then your next vote
can be a parity. I placed pulled fangs in there to KEEP vamps in
torpor seem to work better than disarms I had in there. Originally I
had 4-6 Tastes of Vitae, but I increased the amount of blood dolls as
I found this worked better and is more useful when parity shifting.
